scientific.integrity: The result is an exact Schur-stability analysis of the defining deterministic PNM recurrence on SPD quadratic modes. The three-state matrix, characteristic polynomial, active Jury/Schur inequality, boundary root, and noise-factor reparameterization are derived explicitly.
limitations: Constant learning rate and nonnegative beta-zero only.
No stochastic-noise or nonlinear global-convergence claim.
The result concerns state stability rather than per-step objective monotonicity.

title: Noise amplification imposes an exact deterministic stability tax in Positive-Negative Momentum
